subject: pe
title: Anatomy: Heart & Lungs
welcome_lead: Two organs that never stop — let's see what they do.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: heart, lungs, circulation, breathing.
final_note: When you exercise, your heart and lungs work overtime.

concepts.def: Blood vessel back to the heart.

walkthroughs.body_html: The heart pumps blood around the body. Resting it beats around 60-80 times a minute. During exercise it can hit 200.
Lungs bring oxygen in and breathe CO2 out. Breathing rate rises during exercise to feed working muscles.
Arteries carry blood from the heart. Veins bring it back. Tiny capillaries swap oxygen and CO2 with cells.
